buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (1) Experience: GeM Contract copies along with the copies of the GeM-CRAC/GeM Invoices ‘OR’ The execution/experience certificate issued by the appropriate authority of that organization showing the c ontract value for last 3 (three) years. (2) EMD (Bid Security): (a) The DD may be drawn in favour 'Accounts officer (A & P) O/o CGM BSNL Odisha Circle, Bhubaneswar' p ayable at Bhubaneswar. It should reach the AGM (CPC II), O/o CGM BSNL, Odisha Circle, BSNL Bhawan, Ash ok Nagar, Bhubaneswar -751009 before the bid opening date. ‘OR’

(b) EMD-BG for the EMD amount with validity one month above the offer validity period subject to maximu m 210 days in the format attached under 'Bid Specific ATC. ‘OR’ Appropriate supporting document for exemption of EMD. (3) GSTIN document: Full page of the GST Registration certificate with all the Annexure showing the details of “Constitution of B usiness” and details of the proprietor/ directors/partners etc of the bidder-firm. (4) Make in India (MII): To be given in the attached format given under “Bid specific ATC” (5) Near Relationship Certificate: The bidder should give a certificate that none of his/her near relative, as defined below, is working in the B SNL units. In case of bidder being proprietorship firm, this certificate will be given by the proprietor. For partnership fi rm, the certificate will be given by all the partners. In case of bidder being Company / Limited Company the certificate will be given by all the Directors of the company, but excluding following: a. Government of India/Financial institution nominees and independent non-Official part time Directors, ap pointed by Govt. of India or the Governor of the state and b. Full time Directors of PSUs, both Central and State NB: The near relatives for this purpose are defined as: - (a) Members of a Hindu undivided family. (b) They are husband and wife. (c) The one is related to the other in the manner as father, mother, son(s) & Son's wife (daughter in law), D aughter(s) and daughter's husband (son in law), brother(s) and brother's wife, sister(s) and sister's husban d (brother-in-law). (6) FORMAT OF UNDERTAKING for Non-Blacklisting by the Bidder: Declaration to be sumitted by the Bidder that the Company/ Partnership is not black-listed/ debarred by any PSU or State/UT or Central Government in India as on <the date of the submission of bid> as attached in Annexure-VIII in Buyer added ATC (7) Payment process : After supply of the material as per the contract/Purchase Order, the successful bidde r has to submit their claim invoice to the automated vendor invoice processing portal (VIPA) through their registered mail. In this regard, they have to submit their option for registration to the portal before submis sion of the invoice. A document containing the Option form for registration and guidelines for submission of invoice is available vide Annexure-VI under Bid Specific ATC document. (8) Payment Terms:- 95% payment will be paid after successful installation and commissioning and balance will be paid after co mpletion of warranty period or on production of a Bank guarantee for the equal amount (5%) for a period o f the three year (warranty period) (9) The Bidder is required to submit the declaration for additional specifications parameters mentioned in t he Bid are provided in the PCs and shall upload the same during Bid submission. NB-1: Bidders are required to upload scanned copies of the following documents to fulfil the EMD/Performance S ecurity (which ever applicable). i) Bank Transaction details with UTR Number towards the successful e-payment for EMD. (Mandate Form c ontaining BSNL Bank A/C details is attached at Annexure-VII of ATC documents) ii) DD/ Banker Cheque or Bank Guarantee

iii) Valid MSE Certificate /Udyam Registration certificate (for Micro & Small Enterprise claiming exemptions from Tender Fee/ EMD) iv) The original document of the EMD-DD or EMD-BG should reach the AGM(CPC II), O/o CGMT, BSNL Odish a Circle, Bhubaneswar-751009 within 5(five) days from the bid end date. Else, the bid offer will be treated as without EMD. NB-2: 1) Documents submitted/uploaded post Technical Evaluation shall not be entertained. 2) It may be noted that AWO/APO shall be issued to successful L1 bidder prior to placement of GeM Contra ct Order. The successful L1 bidder is required to show the Original eligibility criteria documents i.e. Experie nce Certificates, Annual Financial Turnover & OEM Authorisation Certificate as uploaded by the bidder in G eM portal during bidding process to the Committee for Evaluation of Tender (CET), Chaired by DGM () O/o CGM BSNL Odisha Circle, BSNL Bhawan, Unit-II, Ashok Nagar, Bhubaneswar f or verification within 7(seven) days of issue of the APO/AWO. NB-3: Submission of Irrelevant, Unnecessary repeat documents should be avoided.
